h.source: Seen work thesaurus, hand-reviewed (scripts/text/work-families.txt); vocabulary from the most frequent verbs and nouns of O*NET 31.0 task statements (USDOL/ETA, CC BY 4.0) and Seen's posting corpus; WordNet 3.1 consulted for candidates
h.licence: Seen original compilation; O*NET-derived vocabulary under CC BY 4.0 (attribution on /methods)
h.format: a[actionFamily] = [[member] | [member, "objFamily|objFamily"]]: a conditional member counts only when the object it acts on is in one of those object families; o[objectFamily] = { f: fields where it holds, m: [[member] | [member, "field|family"]] }: a conditional member counts only in that field or next to that family. Members are lower-case word sequences.
